releaseNote.summary: Runneth is in a code freeze right now. It re-opens Thursday night (June 25), and the next normal release goes out Thursday night too. r42 shipped Monday night (June 22) as the planned pre-freeze release. A few summit-critical releases (r43, r44, r45) went out Tuesday, June 23, and a Meta video link hotfix shipped Wednesday, June 24.
releaseNote.plannedWindow: Code freeze active. Re-opens Thursday night, June 25; next normal release goes out Thursday night, June 25. Already shipped: r42 (Mon, June 22), r43 / r44 / r45 (Tue, June 23, summit-critical), and a Meta hotfix (Wed, June 24).
releaseNote.details: r42 (Monday night, June 22) was the planned pre-freeze release: new Motion workspace ID flags for the Meta and TikTok tools (fixing multi-workspace performance pulls), Builder release notes now posting to Slack, plus deploy and app-auth reliability fixes and a Google OAuth token retry. The code freeze then started Tuesday, June 23, for the CSS summit (Thursday, June 25) and a billing release, with only hotfixes allowed until it re-opens Thursday night, June 25. A few summit-critical releases were cherry-picked through during Tuesday: r43 (clearer error on missing credentials, prod Node pin, image-registry retry jitter), r44 (deterministic sessions, steadier VM recovery), and r45 (bulk VM creation by org, higher provider proxy rate limit). Early Wednesday, June 24, a hotfix fixed v3 Meta video ad URLs that were returning preview-only links. Normal prod releases resume Thursday night, June 25.
releaseNote.statusPagePlacement: Show the next planned release with Recent Releases, alongside the upcoming release entry.

runnethUseOptions.use_when_relevant: Use this whenever the user's request touches this area.
runnethUseOptions.only_when_asked: Use this only when the user asks about or reports this issue.
runnethUseOptions.status_page_only: Visible to CSMs, product, and operators, but not injected into Runneth by default.

resolutionOptions.confirmed_next_release: Confirmed for the next planned release.
resolutionOptions.working_toward_next_release: Working toward the next planned release, but not marked ready yet.
resolutionOptions.in_progress: Being worked on, but not tied to the next planned release.
resolutionOptions.notice_only: Guidance or status visibility; no release fix is implied.
resolutionOptions.resolved: Fixed and shipped. Stays at the bottom of the board for about a day (through removeAfter) so it is visible and gets pulled into the next summary, then drops off.

notices.summary: Multi-workspace performance workspace ID fix shipped in r42.
notices.impact: The Meta and TikTok performance tools previously lacked workspace ID support, causing issues in orgs with multiple workspaces. The fix shipped in r42.
notices.workaround: No workaround needed. The fix is live as of r42.

resolution.label: Resolved
resolution.note: Resolved. Motion workspace ID flag support for the Meta and TikTok CLI tools shipped in r42 (PR #2367). Multi-workspace orgs can now direct performance pulls to the correct workspace.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Show under Data access. Affects only multi-workspace orgs pulling performance data. Fix is in tonight's planned release.
notices.runnethTrigger: User in a multi-workspace org reports a Meta or TikTok performance pull returning the wrong workspace's data or erroring.
notices.runnethGuidance: Acknowledge that the Meta and TikTok performance tools don't yet accept a workspace ID, so multi-workspace orgs can hit issues, and that a fix is in tonight's release. Do not raise this proactively for single-workspace orgs.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture the org, how many workspaces it has, which tool (Meta or TikTok), and what the pull returned versus expected.

notices.summary: OAuth-gated apps can show a rough logged-out screen.
notices.impact: When someone opens an app that requires OAuth while logged out, the gated screen may look unfinished instead of showing a polished sign-in or access prompt.
notices.workaround: Log in to the right Motion/Runneth account, connect the required OAuth account if needed, then reopen or refresh the app link.

resolution.label: Resolved
resolution.note: Resolved. The access-denied page for OAuth-gated apps shipped, so logged-out or blocked users now get a proper access prompt instead of a rough, unfinished screen. A small follow-up to add org context to that page (PDEC-8238) is still in review, but the logged-out screen itself is no longer an issue.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Resolved. The access-denied page shipped; the logged-out OAuth gate screen is no longer an issue. A minor org-context follow-up remains in review but is not user-facing.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks about or reports an app, app link, dashboard, widget, or generated page looking broken, ugly, unfinished, or confusing while logged out or blocked by OAuth.
notices.runnethGuidance: Resolved. The access-denied page for OAuth-gated apps shipped. Do not raise this as an active issue.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture the app link, whether the person was logged out, which OAuth gate appeared, and whether the page still looks wrong after logging in and refreshing.

notices.summary: Sometimes a Slack reply can get dropped.
notices.impact: Once in a while, Runneth can skip its reply to a Slack message, so nothing comes back. The earlier cause of this is already fixed. This last edge case is fixed too and is going out in the next release (Thursday night).
notices.workaround: If a reply doesn't come through, just send the message again.

resolution.label: Fix coming next release
resolution.note: Fixed and going out in the next release (Thursday night). If a reply is ever dropped before then, just re-send the message.

notices.statusPageGuidance: An occasional dropped Slack reply. The earlier cause is already fixed; this last edge case is going out in the next release, Thursday night.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks about or reports an 'internal formatting response' error in Slack, or Runneth posting an error line after being told to stop.
notices.runnethGuidance: If someone reports an 'internal formatting error' or a dropped Slack reply, acknowledge it is a known area: the June 11 and June 19 fixes addressed the original error, and a new related delivery edge case (a turn skipping the response start) is being tracked. Suggest re-sending the message. Do not raise this proactively for normal Slack requests.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture the Slack thread link and whether Runneth had started responding before the error appeared.
notices.errorQuote: I hit an internal formatting error while preparing this Slack response. Please try again.
